findings.title: Browser helper does not enforce its read-only request boundary
findings.detail: Interception matches only HTTP(S) URLs outside the exact origin. All same-origin paths and methods bypass the callback, and WebSocket schemes are outside that regex. Therefore page-generated same-origin POST/control requests and unclassified socket traffic are not refused by this helper. No such live effect is asserted to have occurred.
findings.remedy: Intercept all page/context network requests, allow only GET for an explicit finite read-only document/API/static dependency closure, abort every other request before dispatch, and refuse or explicitly fence WebSocket/service-worker paths. Record refused requests truthfully. Add controlled same-origin POST, forbidden GET/control path, external URL, redirect and socket negative tests; do not rerun live helper before boundary fixed.

findings.title: Browser PASS does not prove route identity, status or checklist
findings.detail: goto response status is discarded. Generic h1/h2, links, text length and any details element suffice. The first details is toggled regardless of identity. Terminal navigation 'Component views' and chart 'Fixture evidence' both produce checklist_details_present=true. Receipt headings also enumerate hidden component content, so a heading's presence alone does not establish visible route content.
findings.remedy: Check actual HTTP status, final URL/path and visible route-specific markers. Identify canonical checklist structurally (stable selector), verify visible expected 18 distinct requirement IDs plus five domains/provenance and honest labels, and toggle its own summary. Chart fixture must have a separate explicitly fixture-only assertion profile. Add 404/500-but-content, wrong-page-200, hidden-heading, navigation-only-details, missing/duplicate-requirement and redirected-route falsifiers.

findings.title: Terminal homeostasis page still omits the visible required checklist
findings.detail: Homeostasis HTML directly wraps the component-filtered HUD rather than the shared shell/checklist. The full terminal screenshot ends after the runtime-identity link and has no visible verification checklist/provenance block. Its navigation details fooled UI2.
findings.remedy: Render the shared checklist outside homeostasis component filtering for every HTML page variant, without changing JSON/plain-text/SSE formats. Verify terminal, each component filter, evolution/components, and default view at desktop/mobile; preserve the missing-checklist receipt.
